description: This file defines the HashInterface interface within the Aws namespace, establishing the contract for classes implementing incremental hashing functionality. It includes method signatures for updating the hash with data, completing the hash to get the digest, and resetting the hash state.

classes.name: HashInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for incremental hashing operations: update, complete, and reset.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash and returns the digest.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hash state for a new hash calculation.
